2. **Rolled back**: The first rollback partially failed (halted after rolling back us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on the bad v2.3.1). I verified state via `get_service_status` and retried the rollback, which completed successfully — all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on `v2.3.0`.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is healthy across all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: The first `create_incident` call timed out, so I checked `list_incidents` before retrying — it turns out the incident **INC-0001** was successfully created (SEV2, checkout-api, full description of the rollback, the partial failure, and recovery). No duplicate was created.
